yt-dlp (experimental Links — not in stable JW Converter releases yet)

Project: https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp
License: Unlicense (public domain dedication) — see upstream COPYING
Windows builds: https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases

JW Converter Phase 1 uses yt-dlp only for local metadata inspection
(--dump-single-json --skip-download). Do not redistribute a stable
installer that bundles yt-dlp until licensing review is complete and
the binary version/hash are pinned in this notice.
